playstyle.identity: Sona is an aura enchanter who provides constant buffs to her team. Her abilities create auras that enhance nearby allies while her ultimate is a teamfight-winning stun.
playstyle.howToPlay: Abilities create auras that buff allies. Q damages and gives damage aura. W heals and gives shield aura. E speeds and gives speed aura. Passive empowers auto after 3 abilities (Q empowered = more damage, W = damage reduction, E = slow). R stuns in a line.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Sona spikes at level 6 with her stun ultimate. Moonstone scales her auras. She's a late-game enchanter who buffs her whole team.

passive.name: Power Chord
passive.summary: After 3 abilities, next auto is empowered based on last ability used.
passive.details: After casting 3 abilities, Sona's next auto is empowered. Effect depends on last ability: Q deals bonus damage, W reduces target's damage, E slows.

abilities.name: Hymn of Valor
abilities.summary: Deal damage to nearby enemies; aura gives allies bonus damage on next attack.
abilities.details: Sona fires bolts at nearby enemies, dealing damage. Creates an aura that empowers allied attacks with bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Aria of Perseverance
abilities.summary: Heal yourself and a nearby ally; aura shields allies.
abilities.details: Sona heals herself and the most wounded nearby ally. Creates an aura that shields allies who stay near.

abilities.name: Song of Celerity
abilities.summary: Gain movement speed; aura speeds nearby allies.
abilities.details: Sona gains movement speed. Creates an aura that grants movement speed to nearby allied champions.

abilities.name: Crescendo
abilities.summary: Play a chord that stuns all enemies in a line.
abilities.details: Sona plays her ultimate chord, dealing damage and stunning all enemies in a line.
